method: Real chunks (apx) queried by the unchanged World.getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity; the unchanged Explosion.doExplosionA (size 4, no exploder) over 400 scenes of 3-8 real entities (item, orb, arrow, primed TNT, ender crystal, a player added first) near a chunk corner and slice border, some moved across a border after they were added. Each attackEntityFrom records its index (when not dead) and runs the real method; an ender crystal's real attackEntityFrom runs its createExplosion(null, .., 6) inline, whose doExplosionA is recorded one level deeper. b85 blastprobe85 adds 300 scenes each of: dragon (the real EntityDragon xa with its seven parts placed at chosen positions, attackEntityFromPart, health, flight target and Random state), hang (real paintings, item frames with and without an item, leash knots with items, crystals, TNT, orbs; the exploder none or a TNT placed by a survival or a creative player; drops logged from spawnEntityInWorld) and crystal (crystals, items, eyes of ender and fishing hooks on the reach gate; the push recorded). Each entity logs its hit events; motion is the push alone (constructor motion zeroed). b86 blastcover86 adds 600 cover scenes: blocks of 110 native kinds (full cubes, glass, fluids, fire, slabs, fences, walls, panes, doors, stairs, plants, redstone parts and other shaped blocks, with chosen metadata) answered by World.getBlock / getBlockMetadata, so the unchanged World.getBlockDensity rays meet them; entities are items, orbs, arrows, TNT, eyes, hooks, an ender crystal, zombies, pigs (adult and baby), spiders, cows and a player with EntityPlayerMP geometry (yOffset 0, eye 1.62F); living entities and crystals also log the damage passed to attackEntityFrom.
